# `kaolin/physics/ParticleSkinning.js`

> **Source:** `engine/kaolin/physics/ParticleSkinning.js`

ParticleSkinning.js — Learned reduced deformation basis from particle sim Inspired by NVIDIA Simplicits: learn a small set of skinning weights that approximate the full FEM simulation at a fraction of the cost. Pipeline: 1. Run full sim for N frames → capture deformation snapshots 2. PCA on displacement field → extract dominant deformation modes 3. Compute skinning weights via least-squares fitting 4. At runtime: blend modes with learned weights → fast approximate deformation This enables: - Real-time soft body preview without FEM solve - LOD: near = full FEM, far = skinned approximation - Baking physics to animation for replay Compatible with: - GPUSoftBody.js — reads back node positions for training - EntityMeshRenderer — applies skinned deformation to visual mesh - SkeletalAnimation.js — similar weight/bone concept

## Functions

### `createDeformationCapture(restPositions)`

Capture deformation snapshots from a running soft body. Call this each frame during a training run.

**Returns:** — accumulates snapshots

Extract dominant deformation modes via PCA on displacement snapshots.

### `computeSkinningWeights(decomposition, capture)`

Compute skinning weights for each node per deformation mode. Uses least-squares: for each snapshot, find mode weights that best reconstruct the displacement.

**Parameters:**

- `decomposition` *(Object)* — — from extractDeformationModes
- `capture` *(DeformationCapture)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** }

- `meanDisplacement` *(Float32Array)* — — from extractDeformationModes

### `evaluateSkinning(evaluator, coefficients)`

- `coefficients` *(Float32Array)* — — length = numModes

**Returns:** — deformed positions (stride 3)

### `fitCoefficients(evaluator, targetPositions)`

Fit mode coefficients to match a target deformation (least-squares). Useful for transitioning from full FEM to skinned approximation.

**Parameters:**

- `evaluator` *(SkinningEvaluator)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `targetPositions` *(Float32Array)* — — deformed positions to match

**Returns:** — optimal coefficients

### `bakeToAnimation(capture, decomposition, fps = 60)`

Bake deformation snapshots into mode coefficient keyframes. Output can drive the skinning evaluator for replay without physics.

**Parameters:**

- `capture` *(DeformationCapture)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `decomposition` *(Object)* — — from extractDeformationModes
- `fps` *(number)* — — frames per second of capture (default 60)

**Returns:** }

### `sampleAnimation(animation, time)`

Interpolate baked animation at a given time.

**Parameters:**

- `time` *(number)* — — seconds

**Returns:** — interpolated coefficients
